summary: CBL International Limited filed a Form 6-K with the SEC reporting an amendment to its existing at-the-market (ATM) sales agreement with sales agent A.G.P./Alliance Global Partners. The amendment updates the agreement to reference Class B ordinary shares following a shareholder-approved dual-class share structure and a 1-for-13 share consolidation effective July 20, 2026. This is a routine administrative filing to align the ATM sales agreement with the company's new share class designations. No new securities offering, pricing terms, or special-situation event is disclosed in the filing.
